{"id":1797057142,"question_id":4033,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"9 months, 1 week","timestamp":1760076777,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"2 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1797057142/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Longest Subsequence With Non-Zero Bitwise XOR","memory":"171.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int longestSubsequence(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        int zero = 0;\n        int result = 0;\n        for(auto x : nums){\n            if(x == 0){\n                zero++;\n            }\n            result = result ^ x;\n        }\n        if(zero == n) return 0;\n        if(result != 0) return n;\n        return n-1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"longest-subsequence-with-non-zero-bitwise-xor","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":911}
